title: Heal and sort a party
description:
Using the same `player` struc, write:

| Function | Effect |
|---|---|
| `heal_all(players, count, amount)` | adds `amount` to every player's hp, but never above 100; returns how many players gained anything |
| `remove_dead(players, count)` | moves the players with hp above 0 to the front, keeping their order, and returns how many are left |
| `sort_by_score(players, count)` | sorts the records by score, highest first (any simple sort; whole 24-byte records move together) |

starter.solution.asm:
struc player
    .id:    resq 1
    .hp:    resq 1
    .score: resq 1
endstruc

heal_all:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

remove_dead:
        mov     rax, rsi
        ret

sort_by_score:
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
struc player
    .id:    resq 1
    .hp:    resq 1
    .score: resq 1
endstruc

heal_all:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  test    rsi, rsi
        jz      .done
        mov     rcx, [rdi + player.hp]
        mov     r8, rcx
        add     rcx, rdx
        cmp     rcx, 100
        jle     .fits
        mov     rcx, 100
.fits:  cmp     rcx, r8
        jle     .same
        mov     [rdi + player.hp], rcx
        inc     rax
.same:  add     rdi, player_size
        dec     rsi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

remove_dead:
        mov     r8, rdi                 ; where the next survivor goes
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  test    rsi, rsi
        jz      .done
        cmp     qword [rdi + player.hp], 0
        jle     .next
        mov     rcx, [rdi + player.id]
        mov     [r8 + player.id], rcx
        mov     rcx, [rdi + player.hp]
        mov     [r8 + player.hp], rcx
        mov     rcx, [rdi + player.score]
        mov     [r8 + player.score], rcx
        add     r8, player_size
        inc     rax
.next:  add     rdi, player_size
        dec     rsi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

; Selection sort: for each position, find the highest remaining score and swap it in.
sort_by_score:
        imul    rsi, rsi, player_size
        add     rsi, rdi                ; rsi = the end
.outer: cmp     rdi, rsi
        jae     .done
        mov     r8, rdi                 ; the best so far
        lea     r9, [rdi + player_size]
.inner: cmp     r9, rsi
        jae     .swap
        mov     rcx, [r9 + player.score]
        cmp     rcx, [r8 + player.score]
        jle     .no
        mov     r8, r9
.no:    add     r9, player_size
        jmp     .inner
.swap:  cmp     r8, rdi
        je      .advance
%assign f 0
%rep 3
        mov     rcx, [rdi + f]
        mov     rdx, [r8 + f]
        mov     [rdi + f], rdx
        mov     [r8 + f], rcx
%assign f f + 8
%endrep
.advance:
        add     rdi, player_size
        jmp     .outer
.done:  ret

hints: `remove_dead` uses two pointers walking the same array: one reads every record, the other writes only the survivors. Copy a record field by field.
For the sort, swap whole records: all three qwords at the same offsets. A small `%rep 3` with `%assign` (lesson 7.02) writes the three swaps for you.
